name: Zoomer buyback spot-price accounting
summary: The buyback contract valued incoming ZOOMER at the current pool spot price, allowing one transaction to exchange attacker-supplied tokens for most of the contract's ETH inventory.
notes: The buyback is a directly executed, non-proxy contract whose 17,526-byte runtime is absent before creation and unchanged from deployment through the pre-incident block.

Within the sole loss receipt, the buyback sends 17.248371112617906458 ETH in five calls and receives five 0.02 ETH inputs, so gross victim depletion net of external input is 17.248371112617906458 - 0.1 = 17.148371112617906458 ETH. Its archive balance falls by exactly the same amount, from 17.300097602045297868 to 0.151726489427391410 ETH. It receives and retains 145,108,836 ZOOMER (four transfers of 30,265,400 plus one of 24,047,236), exactly matching its archive token increase; that attacker-supplied consideration is not a victim asset loss. The 90-second-preceding ETH price is 2,927.14 USD.
